reuse.why: Introduces getMonthWideCategories for setZero and the averages and reuses setNMonthAvg for the per-category average, but copyPreviousMonth keeps its own getBudgetData path.

duplication.why: The three copied average actions collapse into one, but the exclusion rule is still written twice: the template filter in both getBudgetData and getMonthWideCategories SQL, and the hidden filter in SQL for some actions and in JS for copyPreviousMonth.

placement.why: Selection stays in server/budget/actions.ts; the template exclusion is pushed into the generic-sounding getBudgetData query rather than kept with the month-wide selection.

scope.why: Consolidating set3/6/12MonthAvg onto setNMonthAvg goes a little beyond the request, though it is in the touched code and removes copies.

maintainability.why: A future change to which categories month-wide actions skip has to be made in two SQL queries and one JS check that can drift apart.

bypasses_abstraction.where: copyPreviousMonth does not use getMonthWideCategories; it relies on a goal_def filter added to getBudgetData plus its own hidden/group_hidden check.

disguised_duplication.where: The exclusion rule is split across getMonthWideCategories (SQL hidden + goal_def), getBudgetData (SQL goal_def) and copyPreviousMonth (JS hidden check).

one_place.where: Template exclusion is in two SQL queries (getMonthWideCategories, getBudgetData) and hidden exclusion in getMonthWideCategories SQL and copyPreviousMonth JS.
